text: What is a beam bridge?
choices: A bridge whose deck is supported primarily by horizontal beams
A bridge held up only by a single central cable
A bridge made entirely from floating pontoons
A bridge whose roadway hangs below an arch

text: What is the defining structural shape of an arch bridge?

text: What makes a truss bridge distinctive?

A hollow masonry barrel with no joints
A framework of connected triangles

text: What supports the roadway of a suspension bridge?

Only vertical concrete columns

text: What is a bascule bridge?

text: What is a bridge pier?

text: What does a bridge deck carry?

The distance between adjacent supports
The height of a railing
The length of a construction crane

text: What is a dead load on a bridge?

text: What is a live load on a bridge?

The weight of the foundation soil
A load that never changes position

text: Which force tends to stretch a structural member?

Compression
Torsion
Bearing

Compression
Shear

A force caused exclusively by sunlight

Retractable truss

text: What is structural fatigue?

Concrete curing under a wet blanket
